objective: Harden the Gemini Live and primary Vobiz PSTN script generation, language prompts, compiler and tenant script editor
acceptance_criteria: All supported language packs and generation/runtime overlays are inspected; confirmed contradictions are removed with regression coverage
Long-speech and missing-turn-completion recovery is exercised without interrupting ongoing caller speech or duplicating a response
Integration activation and webhook processing fail closed; tools resolve tenant-owned connections and validated catalog actions
Advertised integration actions are mapped to implementation; provider errors do not fabricate success or availability
Confirmed scaling faults in the audited request/runtime paths are corrected and remaining infrastructure limits documented
SAST and targeted security regressions run; ZAP and Strix are attempted against an isolated authorized target or their exact blockers reported
Gemini selected for primary script generation never falls back to a secondary LLM
Editor preserves extra sections and unsaved edits across voice refreshes, reports publish errors, validates drafts and shows saved publication state
boundaries: No production config or data migrations
No live customer integration writes or paid PSTN calls; bounded synthetic Gemini API checks are authorized
Do not claim all vulnerabilities eliminated or capacity proven without evidence
Latest steering: audit primary Gemini Live and new Vobiz PSTN only; do not inspect or test secondary provider/carrier flows
Preserve previously authorized hardening work; do not change production stacks or credentials
verification: targeted and affected regressions, static scan, isolated runtime checks
